scope: Release dashboard inventory for local gates, personal solo-live readiness, plus deferred live/db closeout gates. Local profiles are runnable when dependencies and target environments are available; real-environment gates still require explicit unlock and evidence discipline.

statusLegend.ready: Can be run when normal local dependencies are installed and no live thread owns the target environment.
statusLegend.deferred_live: Requires explicit live environment handoff before running.
statusLegend.blocked_db: Requires database recovery or a safe test database.
statusLegend.inventory_only: Recorded as a gate group; exact run policy should be resolved by the future orchestrator.

gateGroups.purpose: Compile and type-safety checks without live service mutation.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: no production writes

gateGroups.purpose: Vitest unit, route, contract, and governance tests.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: test harness only

gateGroups.purpose: Read-only readiness check for deterministic non-live testing: MSW handlers, DB_CONNECTION_STRING override, boot validation switch, and GitHub Actions Postgres service-container template.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: read-only repo inspection; no app server, live Supabase, DB connection, migration, or production write

gateGroups.purpose: Deterministic frontend/page gates backed by MSW fixtures instead of real backend or live Supabase data.
blockingPrerequisites: Additional pages should define their API fixture contract before being added to this gate.
Each promoted page should cover loading, empty, success, permission-denied, and error states where applicable.
Exploratory or manual observations must be converted into repeatable Vitest or Playwright assertions before being counted here.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: mocked API responses only; cannot close live, DB, RLS, storage, or production-readiness gates

gateGroups.purpose: Future route/client-service contract checks that validate API shape and error semantics without a live Supabase dependency.
blockingPrerequisites: Identify authoritative request/response contracts for the selected route.
Keep contract fixtures in source-controlled test files or project-testing artifacts without secrets.
Do not use contract-only evidence to close live data, RLS, concurrency, or migration gates.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: local contract assertions only; no live service and no production writes

gateGroups.purpose: Future backend integration slice against an ephemeral PostgreSQL database through DB_CONNECTION_STRING, using GitHub Actions service containers first and Testcontainers later if local Docker capacity is acceptable.
commandTemplates: Use project-testing/plugins/github-actions-postgres-service-container.example.yml as the workflow promotion template.
blockingPrerequisites: An ephemeral schema migration and seed command must be selected before this becomes ready.
The CI workflow must not use SUPABASE_MIGRATION_URL, service-role secrets, or production Supabase credentials.
Container evidence can support SQL integration readiness but cannot close Supabase-specific RLS, Advisor, storage, or live migration evidence.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: ephemeral container database only; no live Supabase, no production database, no persistent mutation

gateGroups.purpose: Heavy server WBS, generation, and scheduling Vitest files run through observable per-file slices instead of a silent all-project Vitest run.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: local heavy test execution only; no live or DB commands run

gateGroups.purpose: Architecture, route, metric, status, RLS, and production-claim guards.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: guard scripts only

gateGroups.purpose: Local browser smoke for dashboard shell, collaboration, notifications, task summary, team and join flows.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: local browser/test API behavior only

gateGroups.purpose: Local browser smoke for core project chains and reporting/risk pages.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: local browser/test API behavior only

gateGroups.purpose: Local browser smoke for planning, templates, scope modeling, and monitoring surfaces.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: local browser/test API behavior only

gateGroups.purpose: UI/UX visual, overlap, accessibility, performance, and release smoke gates.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: built client and browser verification only

gateGroups.purpose: Bundle budget and performance-evidence summaries.
blockingPrerequisites: PERFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_SUMMARY_URL or --url is required before running the online performance summary check.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: artifact inspection only

gateGroups.purpose: Non-live v1.4.23.1 capability closeout contracts and client contracts; `production-ready` rows here are capability-status rows, not realTestEnvironmentReady, soloLiveReady, or live production outcome evidence.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: non-live capability closeout contract verification; cannot close realTestEnvironmentReady, soloLiveReady, or productionReady environment gates

gateGroups.purpose: Phase 4 read-only testing tool inventory and boundary check for CloakBrowser, Yingdao RPA, Playwright MCP, and future specialized test tools.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: read-only local file/env/package inspection; no app, live, DB, or browser execution

gateGroups.purpose: Generate all 11 wizard default master-plan business types and fail closed on method conflicts, duration-asset semantic mismatches, dependency cycles, disconnected primary networks, multiple roots or terminals, and critical paths that do not continuously cover project start through handover.
commands: npm exec --workspace=server -- vitest run src/__tests__/wizardGenerationSideEffects.test.ts -t "claimed-ready master plan|executable assembly|executable default master plan"
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: local static wizard generation and report-file writes only; no DB, task, dependency, runtime seed, publication, staging, or production writes

gateGroups.purpose: Read-only source-kit inventory for default master-plan review, duration calibration, dependency writer, runtime publication, and post-publish smoke source inputs.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: read-only source export, no-write material preflight, and no-write readiness seal inspection; no runtime seed import, no duration sample writes, no runtime writers, no publication, no smoke

gateGroups.purpose: Controlled staging write, dependency materialization, runtime publication, readback smoke, and rollback drill for an explicitly authorized default master-plan test project.
blockingPrerequisites: Explicit staging authorization file matching baseline/project/company/environment is required.
The selected env-file must point at the database containing the authorized test baseline.
The staging report must record env-file fingerprint, Supabase project ref, database host, and connection source without secrets.
This gate may write staging task carriers, duration samples, task dependencies, runtime publication rows, and rollback events.
This gate cannot claim production-ready or replace production/live real outcome evidence.
passCriteria: The staging runtime evidence runner exits with status staging_runtime_evidence_written and no blockers.
The summary records taskCarrierCount, durationSampleCount, appliedDependencyCount, source manifest export, and rollback verification.
Readiness may reach staging_runtime_chain_passed, but productionReady must remain false until real production/live outcome evidence exists.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: authorized staging controlled write/publish/rollback only; no production-ready claim, no production seed write, no confirmed production baseline write

gateGroups.purpose: Personal real-environment readiness lane for a single-owner staging or personal live deployment. It separates realTestEnvironmentReady and soloLiveReady from company-grade productionReady.
blockingPrerequisites: A personal handoff file must name the operator, Supabase project ref, environment, and API health evidence before realTestEnvironmentReady can pass.
soloLiveReady requires a non-local base URL, deployment ref, self-approval ref, rollback owner, monitoring owner, rollback plan, monitoring plan, API read smoke, and UI smoke.
This lane must keep productionReady=false and must not be used to bypass production/live real outcome evidence.
passCriteria: The solo-live readiness checker exits with status staging_real_test_ready or solo_live_ready.
staging_real_test_ready may close personal real-test environment setup only.
solo_live_ready may close personal live readiness only; productionReady remains false.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: read-only handoff and evidence reference check; no live write, no production mutation, no runtime publication, no rollback execution, and no production-ready claim

gateGroups.purpose: Live evidence inventory, workspace isolation, C18 evidence contracts, live diagnostics.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: requires live environment ownership handoff and explicit live unlock before execution

gateGroups.purpose: C-18.L07/L08/L09/L10/L11/L12/L14/L15 real concurrency, pressure, query-log, malicious-file, and replay evidence.
requiredEvidence: CloakBrowser or scripted browser/API route evidence may support route health only.
DB query log, lock telemetry, catalog/readback, scale metrics, cleanup, and archived JSON are required for closeout.
Yingdao RPA evidence is manual-assisted only and cannot replace automated pass/fail assertions.
handoffChecklist: Live environment ownership is explicitly handed off and no other thread is running live diagnostics.
Base URL, auth token, company/project/plan identifiers, and disposable test-data boundaries are recorded.
Write approval covers only disposable live evidence paths and includes cleanup owner and retention location.
Artifact root under project-testing/reports/release-*/ is reserved before commands run.
blockingPrerequisites: Missing --include-live or --confirm-live-handoff flags.
Missing live auth token, target IDs, writable disposable data scope, or cleanup owner.
No place to archive DB query log, lock telemetry, pressure metrics, PoC output, and cleanup readback.
Attempt to count CloakBrowser, Yingdao, or MCP-only observation as hard pass evidence.
passCriteria: C-18.L07/L08/L09/L10/L11/L12/L14/L15 each has command, exit code 0, artifact path, timestamp, target IDs, and cleanup/readback evidence.
Concurrency and pressure runs include DB/lock/query telemetry, threshold summary, no data corruption, and no orphan test records outside the disposable scope.
PoC and failure-injection items show the expected guarded failure or recovery path, not just successful route rendering.
Browser or RPA evidence is marked supporting/manual-assisted unless converted into scripted assertions.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: requires live environment ownership handoff, disposable project/test data, auth token, and explicit write approval

gateGroups.purpose: C-15 learning loop live closeout: real samples, strict reward/MAE improvement, pending prediction closure, tenant isolation, canary/stable/rollback evidence.
requiredEvidence: Production-like sample cohort and reward/MAE readback with maeAfter strictly lower than maeBefore and evaluatedDecisionCount > 0.
Pending prediction closure and policy version uniqueness evidence.
Canary approval, monitoring, rollback/supersede, and tenant isolation readback.
handoffChecklist: Live environment ownership is handed off with company/project/candidate identifiers recorded.
Real sample cohort source, tenant boundary, and privacy-safe artifact path are confirmed.
Manual canary/stable approval authority and rollback owner are named before mutation.
Monitoring window and observation owner are recorded before canary approval runs.
blockingPrerequisites: Missing live handoff flags or approval reference.
No production-like cohort, reward/MAE improvement readback path, or pending prediction inventory.
Policy version uniqueness, tenant isolation, canary monitoring, or rollback owner cannot be proven.
Only local scheduler wiring or dry-run output is available.
passCriteria: Real sample cohort, reward/MAE quality with maeAfter < maeBefore and evaluatedDecisionCount > 0, pending prediction closure, and policy version uniqueness are archived with command output.
Tenant isolation readback proves the sample and policy evidence does not cross tenant/company boundaries.
Canary approval, monitoring observation, rollback or supersede path, and stable production observation all have artifact paths.
Summary explicitly marks any Yingdao evidence as manual-assisted and does not use it as the only pass signal.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: requires live environment ownership handoff and explicit approval before any canary/stable mutation

gateGroups.purpose: C-19 canonical wizard/WBS closeout: generated tasks, dependency readback, CPM, initial baseline, user adjustment, confirmed baseline, idempotent revision, rollback, and disposable-project cleanup.
requiredEvidence: Canonical wizard commit created the expected tasks and dependencies in one transaction.
Dependency inventory/readback, CPM, candidate baseline, adjustment, confirmation, revision idempotency, and rollback all passed.
Disposable project cleanup readback shows no business residue; environment classification remains explicit.
handoffChecklist: Production environment, same-SHA private API endpoint, login company context, explicit approval, and disposable-project boundary are recorded.
Migration state and runtime RLS required by the canonical wizard chain are read back before smoke.
Cleanup owner and residue scan are defined before creating the disposable project.
blockingPrerequisites: Current code is not running against the intended staging database or login company context is ambiguous.
Wizard commit, task/dependency readback, CPM, baseline confirmation, revision rollback, or cleanup fails.
The smoke report belongs to another project or omits environment classification.
passCriteria: Wizard commit, task/dependency readback, fresh CPM, baseline confirmation, revision idempotency, and revision rollback are all pass.
Dependency readback matches inventory with zero dangling edges.
Disposable project deletion and residue readback pass; local-current-code, deployed staging, and production/live remain separately classified.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: writes only an explicitly approved disposable production project through canonical product APIs, then confirms revision rollback and physical project cleanup; append-only runtime consumer ledgers are read but never deleted, and duplicate T2 runtime publication tables are never written

gateGroups.purpose: Migration safety, pending migrations, schema drift, production governance, and DB recovery checks.
blockingPrerequisites: A Supabase Management API token, provided as SUPABASE_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN, SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, or SUPABASE_API_TOKEN outside the repository, must be available before the formal Management API Advisor export can run.

If no Management API token is available, use the Dashboard UI Advisor JSON capture fallback: generate the fill-in Dashboard UI capture template with evidence:supabase-advisor:dashboard-ui-template, populate it from the logged-in Supabase Dashboard Advisor page, then normalize it with evidence:supabase-advisor:dashboard-ui-normalize; it must include the dashboard project URL, project ref, current security/performance issue counts, and must not be derived from CLI db advisors.
A Dashboard UI capture template is not evidence. It must have templateOnly=false and current Dashboard counts before normalization.
A CLI Advisor rescan file is supporting evidence only; it cannot replace the Dashboard UI or Management API Advisor export required by MG-07.
The production governance evidence command must receive --advisor-export-file pointing at the current-run formal Advisor export artifact.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: database access required; may be read-only or migration-affecting depending on command

gateGroups.purpose: Old-object cleanup closeout: either controlled physical deletion for approved candidates, or a DB-backed no-safe-candidate closeout when full catalog discovery finds nothing eligible to drop.
requiredEvidence: Object-level rowCount=0 is required but insufficient.
If full catalog discovery finds candidateCount=0, archive old-object-no-safe-candidate-closeout.json and do not execute DROP.
DDL structure export, rollback plan, controlled drop migration, post-drop catalog readback, and post-drop API/browser smoke.
Manual approval and production migration window record.
handoffChecklist: Database recovery or safe test database readiness is confirmed before db profile selection.
Drop candidate bundle includes object inventory, rowCount=0 readback, dependency scan, and migration-window owner.
DDL export, backup location, rollback script, and manual approval reference are recorded before any DROP migration.
Post-drop catalog/API/browser smoke owner and rollback decision window are recorded.
blockingPrerequisites: Missing --include-db or --confirm-db-ready flags.
Candidate object has rows, unresolved pg_depend/catalog references, runtime references, or unknown ownership.
No DDL export, backup, rollback plan, manual approval, or migration window record.
Attempt to close from retired-object audit or rowCount=0 alone.
passCriteria: Physical DROP path: every drop candidate has live rowCount=0 plus pg_catalog/pg_depend/view/function/trigger/FK/RLS/policy/job/seed/migration/import/readback evidence.
Physical DROP path: controlled drop migration, rollback script, approval reference, and migration window record are archived before execution.
Physical DROP path: post-drop catalog readback proves objects are absent and dependencies remain clean, and post-drop API/browser smoke proves runtime surfaces still work.

No-safe-candidate path: full catalog discovery status=no_safe_candidate, candidateCount=0, candidates=[], inspectedCount>0, no DB mutation, and supporting drop guard evidence are archived; this closes only the cleanup obligation, not a physical DROP execution claim.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: database access required; physical DROP must not run without candidate bundle, backup, approval, rollback, and post-drop readback plan

gateGroups.purpose: Future Schemathesis/OpenAPI fuzz and contract testing after an authoritative OpenAPI artifact exists.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: future read/fuzz against test API only

gateGroups.purpose: Future PR visual review workflow if Playwright screenshots become too large for local review.
gateGroups.mutationBoundary: visual artifacts only
